about.title: About Airports API
about.tagline: Global airport reference data — free, open, and authentication-free.
about.description: Airports is a full-stack Go web application providing comprehensive global airport information. It serves data on 35,000+ airports worldwide — ICAO/IATA codes, names, city, country, coordinates, elevation, and type — through a versioned REST API, a GraphQL endpoint, and a server-side rendered web UI.
about.feature_rest: Read-only REST API with JSON, CSV, and GeoJSON exports
about.feature_geoip: GeoIP-based caller location to surface nearby airports
about.feature_geo_queries: Geographic queries: nearby (radius), bounding box, by code
about.feature_webui: Server-side rendered web UI (dark / light / auto theme, mobile-first PWA)

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: The Airports API is a public, read-only reference service. There are no user accounts, no logins, and no tracking cookies.
privacy.collect_logs_desc: standard HTTP access logs (timestamp, method, path, status, response size, user agent) retained only as long as the operator's log rotation policy dictates.
privacy.collect_geoip_desc: used at request time only to surface nearby airports on the home page. The IP is never persisted, never logged in association with results, and never shared with third parties.
privacy.not_collect_accounts: No user accounts, no email addresses, no profile data.
privacy.not_collect_cookies_pre: No cookies for tracking. Theme preference is stored in
privacy.not_collect_analytics: No third-party analytics, no ad networks, no tag managers.
privacy.third_party_desc: GeoIP databases are downloaded from public CDNs at server startup and refreshed weekly. No request data is sent to any third party at runtime.
privacy.api_cookie_essential_desc: Theme preference (dark/light/auto) stored in localStorage only. No server-side session cookies.
privacy.api_cookie_preferences_desc: No user accounts or server-side preferences.
privacy.api_cookie_analytics_desc: No analytics or tracking of any kind.
privacy.api_retention_period: No personal data is collected or retained.
privacy.api_consent_message: This service collects no personal data.
privacy.api_data_usage: Airport data is public reference data served read-only. No user data is stored.
